newsitem.title: USA: Borders workers at NYC store unionize - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Borders workers at NYC store unionize - NYT.

text.p: Employees at one of Borders Group Inc's largest bookstores have voted to join the United Food and Commercial Workers Union, the New York Times said.
In Wednesday's edition, the Times said employees at Borders' store at the World Trade Center in Manhattan voted 55-31 in favor of unionization.
The store is just the fourth of Borders' 167 stores in the United States to unionize.
Jason Chappell, a bookseller at the store, said the union succeeded in securing the votes because employees are having a hard time living in New York on the $7-an-hour wages.

Anne Kubek, vice president of human resources for Borders Stores, said the company was disappointed with the union vote. She attributed the outcome to the greater prevalence of unions in New York City compared with other parts of the country.
